questionPapers.title: Question papers
questionPapers.subtitle: Set each exam paper from the question bank: blueprint, questions, sets and answer keys — approved before they are printed.
questionPapers.notFound: This question paper isn’t there, or isn’t one of yours.

board.notStartedHint: No one has started this paper yet.
board.started: Question paper started. Lay out the blueprint, then fill the sections.
board.limited: You see the papers of the subjects you teach, and the ones you set.
board.noExamsHint: Exams › Exam schedule sets up an exam and its papers; their question papers are set here.

editor.title: {{subject}} · {{cls}}
editor.subtitle: {{exam}} · set by {{setter}}
editor.noBank: The question bank has no questions of this subject for this class yet — write the questions here (and save them to the bank as you go), or add them in Learning › Question bank.
editor.derived: Set {{set}} is set A shuffled. Change set A and it follows.

card.removeConfirm: Take this question off the paper?
card.replaced: Swapped for another question from the bank.

autoPick.short: Picked {{picked}}; the bank had nothing for {{missing}} more — pick or write those.

refillConfirm.title: Pick every question again?
refillConfirm.message: Set {{set}}’s questions are put back and new ones picked from the bank, to the blueprint.

mix.noTarget: No target mix set — the blueprint can have one.

warnings.MARKS_MISMATCH: The sections add up to {{total}} marks; the paper is out of {{max}}.
warnings.MIX_NOT_100: The difficulty mix adds up to {{sum}}%, not 100%.
warnings.WEIGHT_NOT_100: The chapter weightage adds up to {{sum}}%, not 100%.

blueprint.title: Blueprint
blueprint.durationHint: From the exam timetable to start with
blueprint.maxMarksHint: The exam paper is out of {{n}}
blueprint.instructionsHint: One per line; printed as a numbered list at the top.
blueprint.choiceHint: Each question has an alternative; the student answers one of the two.
blueprint.mixHint: Auto-pick aims for this; leave at 0 for no target.
blueprint.chaptersHint: Auto-pick leans towards these chapters; leave empty to draw on every chapter.

errors.title: Name the section
errors.attempt: Between 1 and the number of questions

sets.title: Make sets

hint.SHUFFLE: Same questions as set A, in another order within each section (an OR pair stays together); each set has its own answer key.
hint.DIFFERENT: Each set gets its own questions from the bank to the same blueprint, kept apart from the other sets while the bank lasts.

sets.remake: Sets other than A are made again from scratch.
sets.onlyA: One set for now. Make sets B, C … to stop copying in the hall.
sets.short: Sets made, but the bank ran short for set(s) {{sets}} — fill the gaps there.

form.modelAnswerHint: Printed in the answer key for the examiners
form.schemeHint: How the marks are given, e.g. “Definition 1, example 1”
form.saveToBank: Also save it to the question bank

errors.options: Give the options and mark the correct answer
errors.answers: Give the answer (or answers that count)

syllabus.title: Add from syllabus · {{section}}
syllabus.fitsOnly: Only questions that suit this section
syllabus.directHint: Questions teachers kept for exams on this class and subject’s syllabus topics. Tick the ones you want; each gets this section’s {{marks}} mark(s).
syllabus.finishHint: Questions teachers kept for exams on this class and subject’s syllabus topics. Pick one to open it in the question form — mark the right answer there, then add it. It gets this section’s {{marks}} mark(s).
syllabus.none: No exam questions on this subject’s syllabus yet. Teachers add them in the Teaching hub (a question’s “Use” set to Exam).
syllabus.noneHere: No questions here. Try another unit or topic, or show every kind.

bank.title: Question bank · {{section}} ({{type}})
bank.clickToPick: Click a question to put it in this place.
bank.question: Question
bank.emptyHint: The bank holds this subject’s questions for this class. Add more in Learning › Question bank.
bank.more: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} — narrow the search to see the rest.

submitConfirm.title: Submit this paper?
submitConfirm.message: It can’t be changed while it waits for approval. You can take it back until it is approved.

flow.recalled: Taken back — it is a draft again.

approveConfirm.title: Approve this paper?
approveConfirm.message: It is locked once approved; changing it needs unlocking.

sendBackConfirm.title: Send it back?
sendBackConfirm.message: The setter sees your note and can change the paper.

flow.unlocked: Unlocked — it is a draft again and needs approving.

unlockConfirm.title: Unlock this approved paper?
unlockConfirm.message: It goes back to draft and has to be approved again. The reason is kept in its history.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this question paper?
deleteConfirm.message: Its blueprint, sets and questions go. Questions saved to the bank stay there.

print.draft: DRAFT — this paper has not been approved yet
print.multi: more than one may be correct
print.writeCode: Candidates must write the Code No. on the title page of the answer book.
print.subject: Subject
